Order No. 05 Dated- 20.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Deoghar Mahila P.S. Case No.11 of 2020 instituted under Sections 498A, 323, 341, 342, 379, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that there is matrimonial dispute between the parties and all allegations levelled against the petitioner is entirely false and fabricated.

It is further submitted that both the parties have amicably settled their dispute before the Mediation Center,
JHALSA, hence, the petitioner may be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Deoghar in connection with Deoghar Mahila P.S.
Case No.11 of 2020 with the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the petitioner shall also file undertaking regarding compliance of terms and conditions of settlement arrived at Mediation Center, JHALSA.
